answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cedar lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ocean is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
